easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Yannik until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
